additional_context: Filed a bill "that would have allowed open carry of firearms and let lawmakers carry concealed weapons" in the Capitol.

Filed a bill on the first day of the 2024 session that would have allowed open carry of firearms and let lawmakers carry concealed weapons in legislative meetings and the Capitol complex. It lacked support from House leadership and did not pass. He had filed an open-carry amendment in 2023 but withdrew it after GOP leadership objected.
